headline_marked: [[Paste-Safe]] masks client names before AI chats, then restores them
headline: Paste-Safe masks client names before AI chats, then restores them
summary: This new web app helps freelancers and agencies protect client confidentiality by anonymizing sensitive data before pasting it into AI models like ChatGPT and Gemini.
details: Paste-Safe is a one-page web app designed to safeguard client confidentiality for freelancers, consultants, and agencies who use AI chat models. It works by replacing sensitive client names and details with placeholders before the text is pasted into AI interfaces such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.

Once the AI generates a response, the user pastes it back into Paste-Safe, which then restores the original names and details. This process ensures that private information is not exposed to the AI, while maintaining consistency throughout a conversation, even if the AI alters the format of the placeholders.

The core masking functionality is powered by a BERT-based NER model, dslim/bert-base-NER, fine-tuned for identifying people, organizations, and locations. The application handles tokenization and character offsets to accurately mask names, even across word pieces. For longer texts, it splits content at paragraph and sentence boundaries to maintain context.

To address limitations of the BERT model, especially with informal language or names without clear titles, Paste-Safe 0.2.0 includes custom rules for capitalized names following greetings or appearing alone after sign-offs. An optional second pass using the Gemma 3 270M language model can further identify names missed by the initial pass, enhancing accuracy.

The entire application is built with plain HTML, CSS, and ES modules, running client-side without any server-side processing or build steps. This means the masking model, approximately 110 MB (or 323 MB with Gemma enabled), is downloaded once and cached locally, allowing offline use.

The open-source core of Paste-Safe is available under the Apache-2.0 license. Potential paid features for a side hustle include team-shared masking lists, DOCX and PDF input/output, and a browser extension that masks directly within the chat interface, catering to business needs for enhanced data protection.
